verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party UI extension SDK, custom view framework, or dashboard-widget builder that would let a designer ship custom views that feel native in ClickUp. The Views API only creates and configures ClickUp's own built-in views (grouping, sorting, filtering), and the Figma embed is a separate integration, so both are adjacent rather than the story's capability.

support.subject: As a designer, I can build custom views and dashboard widgets that feel native to the product
